scenes.a: You were about to step into that difficult conversation without asking God for direction first.
Scripture declares, Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Heavenly Father, quiet my anxious heart as I prepare to take this next step. Examine my hidden motives and reveal any subtle path that leads away from your truth.
Grant me divine wisdom to speak with grace, walk in humility, and honor your holy name.
Establish my footing firmly upon your righteous promises, protecting my heart from pride and missteps. Lead every single decision I make today.
Subscribe to The Guided Path to seek God's wisdom for every step.
